newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC may add 100,000 T to wheat stock forecast.
newsitem.headline: ONIC may add 100,000 T to wheat stock forecast.

text.p: France's cereals office ONIC is set to add around 100,000 tonnes to its forecast for season-ending soft wheat stocks on June 30, grain industry sources said on Wednesday.
A draft ONIC report for publication on May 12 lifts the carryover stock projection to 2.12 million tonnes from a previous 2.021 million tonnes published in April, they said.
The new figure is just short of the 1996/97 season's opening stock figure of 2.2 million tonnes.
The proposed revision -- which can be altered before release -- comes despite new rises in projected soft wheat exports for the July/June campaign, now effectively closed.

ONIC and its industry advisers propose to raise projected exports to EU countries to 9.36 million tonnes from a previous target of 9.185 million. Exports outside the EU rise to 6.45 million tonnes from 6.4 million, the sources said.
However, a key consumption category is cut, with wheat used for manufactured animal feed declining to 5.5 million tonnes from a previous estimate of 5.7 million.
Production is seen little changed at 34.56 million tonnes but the amount of crop delivered to the market goes up to 30.51 million tonnes from a previous estimate of 30.45 million.
The figures are part of a draft prepared for ONIC's monthly supply/demand report to be released at 1000 GMT next Wednesday.
ONIC says it never comments on such figures until they are released, pointing out that a full ONIC committee, also meeting on May 12, has the final say over what is published.
